svg.title: Water Divination · developer affinity
svg.desc: Updated 2026-10-28, Asia/Seoul. Code shares count unique committed source files in local projects; TSX and JSX are classified as React, separately from TypeScript. Tests included; generated output excluded. AI shares use the same retained token snapshot as the activity card; cached input included once. Code and AI use separate totals. TypeScript: 82.4%; Python: 0.7%; React: 14.8%; Go: 2.1%; Claude: 1.7%; Codex: 98.3%
